firstNightReminder: If something happened to a player, they learn this.
otherNightReminder: If something happened to a player, they learn this.
name: Tower
ability: Whenever "something" happens to any particular player during the night, they learn this. Whenever a clue is given to any particular player, they learn this.
flavor: From the imagination of Jules Verne...

name: Sun
ability: Name a publicly available resource. All "something" abilities must be sourced from this resource.
flavor: We laugh at the circus because we refuse to be broken by the absurdity.

name: Moon
ability: The Storyteller may accept suggestions for "something" effects if no other good players know about the suggestion.
flavor: A baleful cry, a mourning of shadows, wolves howl as we fill the gallows.

name: Stars
ability: "Something bad" effects can only be malfunctions, character changes, kills, surviving execution, info, or madness. There cannot be off-script effects.
flavor: And when they opened their eyes, the sky was lit to life with a multicolored prismatic glow. They were akin to the gods themselves.

name: Spirit of Ivory
ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
flavor: The Wasteland calls. Bones rise to flesh, then fall to dust. The great spirit grows. The great spirit watches. The great spirit guides. The human listens, or the human is no more."

firstNightReminder: Show the Sorceress their secret word
otherNightReminder: Unless an evil player said the secret word (poisoning the Sorceress), something good happens to each player with an "Enchanted X" reminder.
name: Sorceress
ability: You start knowing a secret word. A clue is left for 3 other players that said it publicly. If an evil player did, you are poisoned.
flavor: Shhh! Listen! Do you hear the rabbits, the birds, the snakes, the sing-song of the crickets, and beetles, and the rhinos, and the caterpillars, and the angels, and the unicorns, and the centaurs, and all the wonderful things that lurk? Speak their names... they will answer!

firstNightReminder: The Scribe points to a player: if "something" would happen to them it happens to the Scribe instead. If the Scribe guesses what it was, (privately) tell them what caused it.
otherNightReminder: The Scribe points to a player: if "something" would happen to them it happens to the Scribe instead. If the Scribe guesses what it was, (privately) tell them what caused it.
name: Scribe
ability: Each night, choose a player: if "something" happens to them tonight or tomorrow day it happens to you instead. Each day, guess what it was: if correct, learn what caused it.
flavor: I was once the captain of a vessel, where every man onboard would be blessed to become the king of their own land. They would come flocking to me in tenfolds, practically throwing coin at my feet. When they reached the shoreline, I was a thousand miles away before they knew they'd become kings of their own abandoned island.

firstNightReminder: The Solomon points to a player. Mark them with "amplified". If something happens to them, the effect becomes obvious if it wasn't already.
otherNightReminder: The Solomon points to a player. Mark them with "amplified". If something happens to them, the effect becomes obvious if it wasn't already.
name: Solomon
ability: Each night, choose a player: if "something" happens to them tonight & tomorrow day, it becomes obvious.
flavor: Even a fool is considered wise if he holds his tongue.

firstNightReminder: The Messenger points to a player. A clue is left for them.
otherNightReminder: The Messenger points to a player. A clue is left for them.
remindersGlobal: If you help them solve it one or both of you might die.
name: Messenger
ability: Each night, choose a player (different to last night): a clue is left for them. If you are mad you have this ability, one or both of you might die.
flavor: Don't shoot!

otherNightReminder: If the night number is equal to the number of Townsfolk the Maker of Friends started in a line with, they die
name: Maker of Friends
ability: Each night*, if it is night X & evil wouldn't win by doing so, you die (X is how many Townsfolk start in a line with you).
flavor: Hey, you there, you like money, right? We'll be good friends then?

otherNightReminder: Show the Bannerman the number of "something" effects occured tonight.
name: Bannerman
ability: Each night*, learn how many "something" effects have occurred since dawn.
flavor: Do you hear the people sing...

name: Astronomer
ability: Each day, privately propose a theory involving multiple other players (not characters): you learn how accurate you are.
flavor: What is it with you and constellations?

name: Echo Archivist
ability: If you die at night, something good happens tonight or tomorrow day. [+0 to +2 Echo Archivists.]
flavor: Sound the horn! God is listening.

firstNightReminder: The Notary points to a player. If they are evil, the Notary is poisoned
name: Notary
ability: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you learn everything they learn & any clues that are left for them. If they are evil, you are poisoned.
flavor: This document is now legally binding.

firstNightReminder: The Mind Warrior chooses any "You start knowing" Townsfolk in the game: they gain that ability.
name: Mind Warrior
ability: On your 1st night, choose a "You start knowing..." Townsfolk in BOTC without setup effects (not homebrew): you gain that ability.
flavor: Every game is a learning experience.

firstNightReminder: Before the game begins, if 1 player declares they will draw no token, then they must be the Warlock. Otherwise, if 1 player was left without a token to draw, they must be the Warlock. Announce that this player is the Warlock to everyone. If any non-Town is still undrawn, then wake a player, show them the "YOU ARE" card, the character they become, and their alignment.
name: Warlock
ability: You will die before the final day. You may publicly choose to die early. [A player draws no token & is a Warlock. A non-Warlock becomes an undrawn non-Townsfolk]
flavor: When one can wield the fire of stars, what use is flesh and bone?

name: Rebel
ability: Exactly one living Rebel has a Townsfolk ability. [+0 to +1 Rebels]
flavor: Fear is a weapon they use. We won't let it control us.

name: Watcher
ability: After you die at night, from now on, each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a clue. Doing so might have a price for those who know.
flavor: Peekaboo, Cthulhu.

firstNightReminder: During the first night, wake the Demon. Show them the THIS PLAYER IS info token, then the Poppet token, then point at the Poppet player. Put the Demon to sleep.
otherNightReminder: If the Demon declared something during the day, wake the Poppet and inform them of what it was.
name: Poppet
ability: Each day, the Demon may privately declare something: you are mad it is true tomorrow or something bad might happen. The Demon knows you are the Poppet.
flavor: Losing your soul in a card game is hardly a way to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

otherNightReminder: If you accept the suggestion, it occurs. If you did not, something bad happens
name: Hypocrite
ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to suggest "something" happens today or tonight. If it doesn’t, something bad might happen to your team instead.
flavor: Lookout! It's a wolf!

name: Bastion
ability: On your 1st night, learn a player: if you don't nominate & execute them by day X, something bad happens, even if dead (X-1 starting Outsiders).
flavor: ARMY TO THE SOUTH! ALERT! TAKE ARMS!

name: The Beast
ability: Exactly 7 "something good" or "something bad" effects will happen, even if for some reason they could not (or there would not be 7). When they would occur, they do so immediately.
flavor: One of us tells only truths. One of us tells only lies. One of us doesn't know nothin'.

name: Beldam
ability: Once per game, declare a curse upon an opposing player: you may decide its nature. If bestowed, they also learn a clue to lift it.
flavor: Dance for me, little puppet. Dance until you break.

firstNightReminder: If 1 or 2 Townsfolk are in a line with the Prism, wake 1 or 2 of them, and inform them of which Outsiders they become. Then, wake the Prism, show them the bluffs, and they choose one.
name: Prism
ability: Something bad might happen to opposing players you nominate. [Up to 2 Townsfolk in a line with you become Outsiders]
flavor: I'm learning about Ancient Rock #435. Did you know that it contained faint traces of amber, copper, and nickel? Not possible, yes? Regardless, it has a terrible refraction index, so it would go terribly with my Ancient Rock #434.

firstNightReminder: The Scraggleworm may choose a player: they are poisoned.
name: Scraggleworm
ability: On your 1st night, choose a good player you had the most "significant interaction" with before the game: they are poisoned. The 1st Townsfolk to nominate is poisoned.
flavor: When infants are left to cry it out, their cries go through a predictable sequence of behaviours: 1) PROTEST - loud cries and restlessness. 2) DESPAIR - monotonous cry, inactivity, gradual withdrawal. 3) DETACHMENT - renewed interest albeit remote, withdrawn, distant. A baby, left to "cry it out," will eventually stop crying. But it won't be because distress has been eliminated, but rather the baby learns that there is no longer any hope.

name: Impresario
ability: Once per game, request that the Storyteller breaks the game rules. Additionally, if granted, things happen the way you say they do.
flavor: I suppose we *must* entertain the masses.

firstNightReminder: Inform all players the Angel of Roses is in play. Do not hand out character tokens. Then, wake all evil players: show them the 'You are' card and their characters.
otherNightReminder: The Angel of Roses points to a player. That player dies. If a player died today or tonight, wake them, and show them the 'You are' info token and their character.
name: Angel of Roses
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Dead players know themselves. [Good players don’t know who they are]
flavor: Walk with me into my garden, betwixt these heavens and hells, and salvation we shall find.

otherNightReminder: The No Fear points to a player. That player dies. If the 1st nominee today was good, they die
name: No Fear
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Each day, if the 1st nominee was good, they die tonight.
flavor: Put your courage to the sticking place!

firstNightReminder: Something bad happens during setup. Place the "rage" reminder where appropriate.
otherNightReminder: The Rage of Genesis may point to a player: that player dies. If they did not, "something bad" happens.
name: Rage of Genesis
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If you didn't, something bad happens & a clue is left as to its nature. [Something bad happened]
flavor: In the beginning, the Earth was nothing but a formless void. MY formless void.

otherNightReminder: The Devil of Sands points to 2 players. The 1st player dies. The 2nd player wakes to recieve a threat. If a threatened player disobeyed, something bad might happen to them.
name: Devil of Sands
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: the 1st dies, the 2nd is mad about something bad. If they are not, something bad might happen to them.
flavor: Empty, rolling tides of soulless valleys. Does the desert with no people contain any evil? Is it evil to accept obliteration?

firstNightReminder: At dawn, ask the Inquisitor if they would like to move seats. If they agree, they move seats to neighbor a living player who you think the Inquisitor's team should execute the most/least.
otherNightReminder: At dawn, after announcing who has died, ask the Inquisitor if they would like to move seats. If they agree, they move seats to neighbor a living player who you think the Inquisitor's team should execute the most/least.
name: Inquisitor
ability: Each dawn, if you agree, your seat moves to neighbor an alive player the Storyteller thinks your team should execute most or least (you don't know which).
flavor: Smells like heresy!

name: Historian
ability: Once per game, publicly declare a myth or legend: you may visit the Storyteller to gain an ability similar to it.
flavor: Rinse and repeat.

name: Misery Wise
ability: Once per game, publicly choose a player & declare a curse. If bestowed, they also learn a clue to lift it.
flavor: A bat first grew wings and of the proper kind, by its desire being organic enough to reach the sub-consciousness. If its desire to fly had been conscious, it would have had to wait till it could have done so by the same means as ourselves, i.e. by machinery.

name: Lord of the Wind
ability: Once per game, add the Hell's Librarian or Angel in to play & choose their effect. It leaves play when you die.
flavor: Relinquish all control you thought you had. We're just getting started.

name: Whisper of Firs
ability: Once per game, you may publicly rearrange the words of another character. If permitted, the character remains reworded until you die.
flavor: We are all but symbols of some greater thing, subject to change and growth. When we forget that metaphoric sense of ourselves, we lose sight of the overall path.
